info.title: ListsWebApp Test Control API
info.description: Test control services for functional tests.

post.summary: Identify the current test by logging test correlation metadata from the request context.
post.description:
IMPORTANT: Every test should call this endpoint at the start of execution to ensure
that test correlation metadata is properly logged and associated with the test run.
Extracts test name, test ID, and test class from Activity tags (set by TestCorrelationMiddleware)
and logs them explicitly. Useful for verifying test correlation is working correctly.

post.summary: Create multiple test users with credentials
post.description:
All users are automatically approved (email confirmed) for immediate use in tests.
User name is prefixed with __TEST__ if not already present, and a unique suffix is added to avoid collisions.
Each user receives a unique, secure random password.

requestBody.description: Collection of usernames to create (doesn't need to include __TEST__ prefix, it will be added)

201.description: Collection of created user credentials including IDs and passwords

delete.summary: Deletes all test users from the system.
delete.description: Deletes all users whose username contains the __TEST__ prefix.

put.description:
This simulates the email approval step. When a user is created, they have to be
approved before they can log in. Only users with __TEST__ in their username can be approved
via this method.

post.summary: Create multiple test users from provided credentials (V2 - accepts full credentials).
post.description:
V2 endpoint that accepts complete credential objects from the client.
Client generates unique usernames and passwords, server just validates and stores in DB.
All usernames must start with __TEST__ prefix for safety.
Supports parallel test execution by allowing client-side credential generation.

requestBody.description: Collection of credentials including username, email, password

201.description: Collection of created user credentials with IDs populated

delete.summary: Delete specific test users by username list (V2 - requires explicit list).
delete.description:
V2 endpoint that requires explicit username list for safety.
Empty or null list returns 400 Bad Request (no "delete all" behavior).
All usernames must start with __TEST__ prefix.
Supports parallel test execution by only deleting specified users.

requestBody.description: Collection of usernames to delete. Must not be empty.

post.summary: Create a workspace for a test user with specified role.
post.description:
Validates that both username and workspace name have __TEST__ prefix for safety.
Returns 403 if either username or workspace name lacks the prefix.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username (must include __TEST__ prefix) of the user.

post.summary: Assign a user to an existing workspace with a specific role.
post.description:
Validates that both user and workspace have __TEST__ prefix for safety.
Returns 403 if either username or workspace name lacks the prefix.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username (must include __TEST__ prefix) of the user.

parameters.name: workspaceKey
parameters.description: The unique key of the workspace.

post.summary: Seed test transactions in a workspace for a user.
post.description:
Validates that user has access to the workspace and both user and workspace have __TEST__ prefix.
Uses anonymous tenant access policy to allow unauthenticated seeding of test data.
The authorization handler sets the tenant context, and TenantContextMiddleware applies it
before TransactionsFeature is injected via DI.
Returns 403 if either username or workspace name lacks the prefix.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username (must include __TEST__ prefix) of the user.

parameters.name: tenantKey
parameters.description: The unique key of the workspace.

post.summary: Seed precise test transactions in a workspace for a user.
post.description:
Validates that user has access to the workspace and both user and workspace have __TEST__ prefix.
Each transaction in the collection is automatically validated by FluentValidation before this method executes.
Uses anonymous tenant access policy to allow unauthenticated seeding of test data.
The authorization handler sets the tenant context, and TenantContextMiddleware applies it
before TransactionsFeature is injected via DI.
Returns 403 if either username or workspace name lacks the prefix.
Returns 400 if any transaction fails validation (automatic via FluentValidation).
Unlike SeedTransactions which generates random transaction data, this endpoint accepts
precise transaction details provided by the caller.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username (must include __TEST__ prefix) of the user.

parameters.name: tenantKey
parameters.description: The unique key of the workspace.

requestBody.description: The collection of transactions to create, wrapped for automatic validation.

post.summary: Seed one transaction with its ordered splits in a workspace for a user.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username (must include __TEST__ prefix) of the user.

parameters.name: tenantKey
parameters.description: The unique key of the workspace.

requestBody.description: The transaction payee and split allocations.

201.description: The created transaction including its ordered splits.

post.summary: Seed payee matching rules in a workspace for a user.
post.description:
Validates that user has access to the workspace and both user and workspace have __TEST__ prefix.
Each rule is automatically validated by FluentValidation before this method executes.
Uses the same tenant access policy as SeedTransactionsPrecise to establish tenant context
before PayeeMatchingRuleFeature is injected via DI.
Returns 403 if either username or workspace name lacks the prefix.
Returns 400 if any rule fails validation, without creating any rules.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username (must include __TEST__ prefix) of the user.

parameters.name: tenantKey
parameters.description: The unique key of the workspace.

requestBody.description: The collection of rules to create, wrapped for automatic validation.

201.description: The collection of created payee matching rules.

post.summary: Seed test import review transactions in a workspace for a user.
post.description:
Validates that user has access to the workspace and both user and workspace have __TEST__ prefix.
Generates deterministic transaction data via ImportReviewFeature.SeedTestDataAsync().
Uses anonymous tenant access policy to allow unauthenticated seeding of test data.
Returns 403 if either username or workspace name lacks the prefix.
All transactions are marked as New status. The first selectedCount transactions are marked as selected.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username (must include __TEST__ prefix) of the user.

parameters.name: tenantKey
parameters.description: The unique key of the workspace.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of import review transactions to create.

parameters.name: selectedCount
parameters.description: Number of transactions to mark as selected. Defaults to all transactions.

201.description: Count of seeded import review transactions.

delete.summary: Delete all test data including test users and test workspaces.
delete.description:
Deletes all workspaces with __TEST__ prefix and all users with __TEST__ prefix.
Cascade deletes will remove associated role assignments and transactions.

post.summary: Create multiple workspaces for a user in a single request.
post.description:
Validates that username and all workspace names have __TEST__ prefix before creating any.
Returns 403 if username or any workspace name lacks the prefix.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username (must include __TEST__ prefix) of the user.

requestBody.description: The collection of workspace setup requests.

201.description: The collection of created workspace results with keys and roles.

delete.summary: Delete multiple test workspaces by their keys.
delete.description:
Validates that all workspaces have __TEST__ prefix for safety.
Cascade deletes will remove associated role assignments and transactions.
Returns 403 if any workspace name lacks the prefix.
Empty or null list returns 400 Bad Request (no "delete all" behavior).

requestBody.description: Collection of workspace keys to delete. Must not be empty.

get.summary: List available error codes that can be generated for testing

200.description: A collection of error code descriptions

get.summary: Generate various error codes for testing purposes
Get a paginated result of test strings.
get.description:
This endpoint is for testing pagination UI components with a simple string data type.
Generates strings in format "Item N" where N is the sequential item number.

200.description: A paginated result containing test strings.

post.summary: Test endpoint to verify CollectionRequest validation is working.
post.description:
This endpoint accepts a CollectionRequest of TransactionEditDto and returns success
if FluentValidation passes. It does NOT create any transactions. Use this to test
that collection validation is working correctly before calling seed-precise.

requestBody.description: Collection of transactions to validate (but not persist).

200.description: 200 OK if validation passes, 400 Bad Request if validation fails.

TestUserCredentials.description: Data transfer object for test user credentials including unique identifier

id.description: The unique identifier (GUID) of the created user

shortName.description: The short username without __TEST__ prefix or unique run ID

TenantResultDto.description: Data transfer object representing a tenant in API responses.

key.description: The unique identifier for the tenant.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the tenant was created.

WorkspaceCreateRequest.description: Request to create a workspace for a test user.

name.description: The name of the workspace (must include __TEST__ prefix).

role.description: The role to assign to the user (default: Owner).

UserRoleAssignment.description: Request to assign a user to an existing workspace.

role.description: The role to assign to the user in the workspace.

amount.description: Transaction amount (can be negative for credits/refunds)

payee.description: Recipient or payee of the transaction (max 200 chars)

category.description: Category from the single split, or empty for multiple splits or no category

hasMultipleSplits.description: Whether the transaction has more than one split

TransactionSeedRequest.description: Request to seed transactions in a workspace.

memo.description: Optional memo text to apply to all seeded transactions.

source.description: Optional source text to apply to all seeded transactions.

externalId.description: Optional external ID text to apply to all seeded transactions.

category.description: Optional category text to apply to all seeded transactions.

CollectionRequestOfTransactionEditDto.description: Generic wrapper for collection requests that require validation of each item.

items.description: The collection of items to validate.

TransactionEditDto.description: Transaction data for creating or updating transactions (input DTO).

amount.description: Transaction amount (can be negative for credits/refunds)

payee.description: Recipient or payee of the transaction

source.description: Source of the transaction (optional, typically from importer)

externalId.description: Bank's unique identifier (optional, for duplicate detection)

category.description: Category for the single split (optional, auto-sanitized)

TransactionDetailDto.description: Complete transaction data including all fields (output-only).

amount.description: Transaction amount (can be negative for credits/refunds)

payee.description: Recipient or payee of the transaction

externalId.description: Bank's unique identifier for duplicate detection

category.description: Category from the single split, or empty when there are multiple splits or no category

splits.description: Gets allocations in display order for multi-split transactions; otherwise empty.

TransactionSplitDto.description: A transaction's category allocation returned for display.

amount.description: Signed amount allocated to this split.

TransactionSplitsSeedRequest.description: Request to seed one transaction with its ordered splits.

splits.description: The ordered split allocations to create.

SplitEditDto.description: Data for adding or updating a transaction split.

amount.description: Signed amount allocated to this split.

category.description: Optional category; an empty or missing value means uncategorized.

PayeeMatchingRuleResultDto.description: Payee matching rule data returned from queries (output DTO).

payeePattern.description: Pattern to match against transaction payee (substring or regex)

payeeIsRegex.description: If true, PayeePattern is treated as regex; if false, as substring

category.description: Category to assign when rule matches (already sanitized)

modifiedAt.description: When the rule was last modified (used for conflict resolution)

lastUsedAt.description: When the rule last matched a transaction (null if never used)

matchCount.description: Number of times this rule has matched transactions

CollectionRequestOfPayeeMatchingRuleEdit.description: Generic wrapper for collection requests that require validation of each item.

items.description: The collection of items to validate.

PayeeMatchingRuleEditDto.description: Payee matching rule data for creating or updating rules (input DTO).

payeePattern.description: Pattern to match against transaction payee (substring or regex)

payeeIsRegex.description: If true, PayeePattern is treated as regex; if false, as substring

category.description: Category to assign when rule matches

WorkspaceSetupResult.description: Result of workspace setup including key, name, and assigned role.

key.description: The unique identifier of the created workspace.

role.description: The role assigned to the user.

WorkspaceSetupRequest.description: Request for setting up a workspace with a specific role.

role.description: The role to assign to the user.

ErrorCodeInfo.description: Information about an error code available for testing

code.description: The error code to use in the query parameter

description.description: Description of what error will be generated

PaginatedResultDtoOfString.description: Generic paginated result container for API responses.

items.description: The collection of items for the current page.

metadata.description: Pagination metadata including page numbers, counts, and navigation flags.

PaginationMetadata.description: Contains all calculated pagination metadata values.

pageSize.description: The number of items per page.

totalCount.description: The total number of items across all pages.

totalPages.description: The total number of pages available.

hasPreviousPage.description: Indicates whether a previous page exists.

hasNextPage.description: Indicates whether a next page exists.

firstItem.description: The index of the first item on the current page (1-based), or 0 if no items exist.

lastItem.description: The index of the last item on the current page (1-based), or 0 if no items exist.
